author: ImTheRealBakugo
body:
Age: 17 to 18
Timezone: GMT Madrid-Spain +01:00
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? I have experience on other games, but on minecraft I have never been part from the staff team.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? I think that my biggest weakness is that if I think that something it´s good(for me) I will do it, and if something is bad (in my opinion) I won´t be agree with it. Well, I think that this weakness will no affect me on moderating to much, because if I have a big responsibility I think more and the problems I can cause with my decision.

What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? My biggest stength is that I am a calm person and I think that this is an important strength because sometimes you have to deal with people who don´t want to hear you and don´t want to do the things right so in that situations you must be relaxed and not going like if you were going to kill them for being inflexible.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? I think that the Staff Team needs new people who are playing regularly, because when I play sometimes there isn´t any mod at the game and when the hackers enter they ruin the entire game and the people get tilted and starts to hate the server. and people which knows how many problems have the servers such as hackers, people who rage  etc.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? In my opinion a leader needs to know how to deal with difficult situations, because on bad situations some people don´t know how to face it and may take bad solutions which can be a big problem for the server, with a great ability to manage the people, also needs to be flexible and needs to be a mature person, and I think that this is the most important quality because an unmature person will do more harm than good to the server or to anyone because a person who cant control himself is not going to to good him/her job.

Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? I don´t consider me to be a leader, because I don´t have the ability to manage the people to do things correctly and guide them to a good way.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? I think that I don´t have an attribute that can distinguish me from other people who may want to be moderators, because at my age the people have to know what to do and what not. And they must have certains things clear that by age people may not know.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? As I said before I think that a person must have clear somethings and have to know how to deal with different types of people because each person is a world and what you think it´s good for one, it may not be good for others.

Do you believe you have these skills? I believe that I have those skills because in my daily life I had to deal with many types of situations, so I think that I´m prepare to face them.

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? I think I can be moderating for a long time because I do not have any priority at the moment. Although all of this could change if I have a lot of work in university. So I think I can be at least a year and a half.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? In this case I would track this player and would be pointing all the infractions and all the alts that can create. And once this monitoring is completed, I would do a report of everything the player has done during this time and I would send it to the staff so they would consider what to do.

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? In this case I would talk to the staff and propose an immediate expulsion because a moderator must be a mature and coherent person. Apart also I would ask for him ban on the forum because he can get angry and if he has been a long time in the staff can know things that can end up hurting the server.

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? In this case I would not take away the punishment, because if I know that he has broken the rules, although there is no physical evidence that can demonstrate at that moment the infraction, I will keep the punishment because the punishment was put in the moment in which there was evidence of the infraction.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? In this case I would not consider this as an infraction, but as something that the moderator wanted to pass and did not want the rest of the people to know. But I would still block the post because I would consider it as spam.

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do? In this case I would ask for more information about the reason for the decision and depending on the reasons why this decision has been taken, I would support it or not depending on how they will affect what has been decided.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? For me it would be a pleasure to be part of the Avicus staff team because it is a server that I appreciate a lot and whom I would like to help because I think I have to return all the help they have given me and all the support I have received from the community .

How passionate are you about Avicus? I likeAvicus very much because it is a server that seeks to support its players and be a server that wants to grow and improve but without removing the essence of the server which is why I came here more than two years ago.
What does Avicus mean to you? Avicus for me has always been a place where I can have fun without being criticized by other people for my way of being and hopefully find such lovely people who have played with me and with whom I had very good times.

Do you speak any other languages than English? I speak Spanish because it´s my native language.
